productionGuards: Re-audit current main for each candidate immediately before production to prevent duplicate creation from concurrent work.
OSM island records must preserve their exact object identity; no ferry-stop, beach or nearest-place point may replace an island object.
Heggholmen and Rambergøya use exact official SSR island objects because the connected landform does not expose separate accepted island polygons in the strict OSM gate.
Ingierstrand bad uses the exact official SSR Badeplass object as the whole-site semantic anchor; the restaurant/building address is not the canonical place identity.
Steilene remains one archipelago-level canonical candidate in this source pass.

County placement must follow the physical municipality: Steilene and Langøyene are in Nesodden/Akershus; Ingierstrand bad is in Nordre Follo/Akershus. They must not be forced into Oslo data paths merely because the source is VisitOSLO.
